LanguageData.Gun_AVT-40_RWP.label: AVT-40
LanguageData.Gun_AVT-40_RWP.description: The AVT-40 is a semi-automatic rifle known for its long range and high damage output. Originally designed as a versatile combat weapon, it offers colonists a reliable option for engaging enemies at a distance. While it boasts a slower firing rate compared to other firearms, each shot delivers substantial stopping power, making it suitable for skilled sharpshooters. The AVT-40 is prized for its effectiveness in open combat scenarios, though its bulk and recoil may pose a challenge in close quarters or rapid engagements.
